description: Delete a design: it moves to the trash with its history, access list, overlay and discussion, and is gone from every listing and tool until ui_builder_restore_design brings it back, which works until `restorableUntilEpochMillis` in the reply (a day). After that it is purged for good. Only the owner may delete, or an agent acting for the owner: on a design it created itself under its current grant, or on any of the owner's designs when the approver also ticked `ui-builder-destructive` — never an editor, a viewer, or anybody merely holding a write grant. Without that capability a session can clean up the designs it made and nobody else's; ask for it with request_access when you are asked to delete existing designs. A trashed id cannot be reused until it is restored or purged. Not the released envelope: the contract has no delete, so the reply names the design and its restore deadline.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_delete_design
